notes:
- Friends with Tailscale: your friends now show up in "Who can connect" with a Test button (Tailscale's own relay machines filled the list before).
- Each server gets its exact Tailscale address, port included (like 100.80.233.40:25566). The numbers always work, even when the .ts.net name doesn't.
- PandA shows when this box isn't connected to Tailscale, and restarts Tailscale by itself if it stays cut off for 2 minutes.
